scenes.ta: ஒரு கண் திடீரெனத் தெரியவில்லையா? இது அவசரம்!
scenes.say: Did one eye suddenly go dark or blurry? This is an emergency. Here are three signs you must never ignore.

scenes.en: The retina needs constant blood flow. A blocked vessel can damage it within hours.
scenes.ta: ரெட்டினாவுக்கு ரத்த ஓட்டம் தடைபட்டால் சில மணி நேரத்தில் பாதிப்பு
scenes.say: Why? The retina at the back of the eye needs a constant blood supply. If a blood vessel gets blocked, damage can start within hours.

scenes.en: Sudden blur or loss of sight in one eye, even without pain.
scenes.ta: 1. வலி இல்லாமல் ஒரு கண்ணில் திடீர் பார்வை இழப்பு
scenes.say: Sign one. Sudden blur or loss of sight in one eye, even if there is no pain.

scenes.en: A dark curtain or shadow moving across your vision.
scenes.say: Sign two. A dark curtain or shadow moving across your vision.

scenes.en: Sight goes for a few minutes, then comes back. Still urgent!
scenes.say: Sign three. Your sight goes for a few minutes, then comes back. It is still urgent. It can be a warning sign of a stroke.

scenes.en: With a drooping face, weak arm or slurred speech, it may be a stroke. Call 108.
scenes.ta: முகம் கோணல், கை பலவீனம் இருந்தால் உடனே 108 அழையுங்கள்
scenes.say: Did you know? If vision loss comes with a drooping face, a weak arm, or slurred speech, it may be a stroke. Call one zero eight right away.

scenes.en: Don't wait to see if it gets better. Regular eye tests help too.
scenes.say: Don't wait to see if it gets better. Go to a hospital emergency right away. And for everyday eye care, book a regular eye test.
